taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Sensitive context entering analytics event properties and destinations
controls.source_trace: Trace an actual application-issued sensitive value into an event payload and intended recipient. Separate synthetic arbitrary query forwarding from proof of sensitive production context.
controls.implementation_branch: Trace source fields through event construction, SDK hooks, batching and final destination payload. A public client identifier is distinct from a login/access token or private phone field. A synthetic value queued in memory is not yet external disclosure; establish transmission and destination role without testing credentials or sending real user data to an ad endpoint.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned test flow with a synthetic value issued by the real fixture consumer and an inert equal-shape control; inspect only tester data.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A parameter named token or phone is not proof of valid credentials/PII; a random marker on an error page establishes generic forwarding only.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Remove or transform protected fields before dispatch and verify legitimate event usefulness and no sensitive value across relevant formats.
